title: Tyler Cowen & Alex Tabarrok on AI, Jobs, and Economic Growth

reader_summary.headline: In the world with strong AI, there's a kind of moral nervousness that sets in.
reader_summary.overview: In the world with strong AI, there's a kind of moral nervousness that sets in. So I'm much more likely to tell people like, hey, you'd better pass in your seatbelt. Like you don't want to miss out on what's coming, how many years you might live.

thesis: The speakers argue that while strong AI will displace some jobs, it will simultaneously create many new ones, allowing for indefinite full employment provided government policy does not interfere. They contend that growth is the most important variable in technological change, as it creates new industries and raises living standards even when specific future jobs are unpredictable, with new roles emerging in sectors like energy, elderly care, and messy jobs that require human coordination.
